设计 SSR/CSR 一体化请求基础设施，统一签名、地区、语言与来源校验机制，沉淀通用 API 层并降低跨端调用复杂度与接口风险。
搭建跨区域支付编排能力（PayPal/Stripe/Airwallex/本地钱包），实现订单轮询与用户权益同步闭环，支撑多市场商业化支付路径。

基于 splitChunks 制定分包策略并优化生产构建行为，降低关键页面资源负载并改善前端性能与发布稳定性。
resume_bullet_templates_en: Led the frontend architecture of a large Next.js 14 analytics platform, governing {router_rules_count}+ route rules and {locales_count} locales via middleware-driven locale/region/device policies.
Designed a unified SSR/CSR request infrastructure with signing, locale/region headers, and source validation, reducing cross-runtime API inconsistency and integration risk.
Implemented region-aware payment orchestration (PayPal/Stripe/Airwallex/local wallets) with order polling and post-payment entitlement synchronization across user states.
Built a centralized growth tracking dispatcher across Google/Facebook/Bing/TikTok/Reddit/LinkedIn, standardizing conversion events for attribution and experiment analysis.
